stem: Which situation motivated the repeal of the Eighteenth Amendment prohibiting the manufacture and sale of alcohol?

options.label: A
options.text: The need to generate revenue after removing protective tariffs in the 1920s

options.label: B
options.text: The need to ration the consumption of agricultural goods in the 1940s

options.label: C
options.text: The need to reduce the federal deficit after the Cold War

options.label: D
options.text: The need to promote economic recovery during the Great Depression
